title: Paula Harris gets an Audrey call about Crestone

tellings.quote: herself boy that's beautiful I'd like to go and the phone rang and Audrey is on the phone she says don't worry you'll go back

plain: The researcher Grant Cameron told the podcast host Jesse Michels a story about a woman named Paula Harris and Crestone, a small town in Colorado, in a conversation that also mentions the UFO campaigner Steven Greer. As Cameron tells it, Harris was thinking to herself how beautiful the place was and that she would like to go, when the phone rang and a woman named Audrey said, "Don't worry, you'll go back." The story is told because the call seemed to answer a private thought before it was spoken aloud.
